definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate + 2-iminoacetate + [sulfur-carrier protein ThiS]-C-terminal Gly-NH-CH2-C(O)SH = 2-[(2R,5Z)-2-carboxy-4-methylthiazol-5(2H)-ylidene]ethyl phosphate + [sulfur-carrier protein ThiS]-C-terminal Gly-Gly + 2 H+ + 2 H2O.
label: thiazole synthase activity
